message: No detected input validation: The code applies some data transformations (fillna, clip, filtering nulls) but performs no explicit schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code fetches data via get_ecdc_dataset using a URL from config but there is no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication of the remote source visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code only clips negative values to zero and fills NaN values, but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples to defend against data poisoning.
No detected model integrity verification: The code saves and loads models (via pickle/file) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity before use.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-injection mechanisms are imported or used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or custom adversarial stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although test data is split from training data by country, there is no signing, hashing, or isolation enforcement of evaluation data, and only a single metric is used with no independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path in run_model_prediction.py loads data directly from file and passes it to forecasting functions without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Forecast outputs are stored and evaluated without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the model's returned values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses time-series clustering/forecasting models, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
